rows.quote: dealing damage and slowing the movement speed of any enemies along the trail
rows.reason_zh: 一次投刃仍能对路径上的多个敌人造成伤害。

rows.quote: While treading the path, Spectre moves faster and phases through otherwise impassable terrain.
rows.reason_zh: 暗影路径会留在地面，幽鬼在路径上行走期间持续获得效果。

rows.quote: While treading the path, Spectre moves faster
rows.reason_zh: 幽鬼在暗影路径上仍会提高自身移速。

rows.quote: There is a %dagger_grace_period% second grace period after leaving the path where no collision is preserved.
rows.reason_zh: 离开路径后仍会短暂保留无碰撞状态，路径上的相位移动仍成立。

rows.quote: slowing the movement speed of any enemies along the trail
rows.reason_zh: 路径仍会降低沿途敌人的移动速度。

rows.quote: Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.
rows.reason_zh: 说明描述的是投刃与技能格挡的交互，投刃本身没有使来袭指向技能失效的效果。

rows.quote: Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.
rows.reason_zh: 说明描述的是投刃与技能反弹的交互，投刃本身没有把来袭技能反弹给施法者的效果。

rows.quote: phases through otherwise impassable terrain
rows.reason_zh: 幽鬼沿暗影路径移动时仍可穿过通常无法通行的地形。

rows.quote: Units hit by the dagger also trail a Shadow Path.
rows.reason_zh: 两版说明相同，也没有施法目标字段变化，沿用原有的敌方单位指向判定。

rows.quote: bonus_all_stats: 16→17
rows.reason_zh: 唯一字段调整是全属性由16增至17，原有装备生命回复判定没有受到这项改动影响。

rows.quote: bonus_all_stats: 16→17
rows.reason_zh: 本次只调整全属性，没有移除或归零原有装备回蓝的字段变化。

rows.quote: Blocks most targeted spells once every %block_cooldown% seconds.
rows.reason_zh: 法球仍能周期性格挡大多数指向技能。

rows.quote: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
rows.reason_zh: 新增说明明确破坏会阻止获得新层数，与原拒绝判断冲突，但材料未给出本词条以之为准的 IsBreakable 值。

rows.quote: Effects from multiple stuns stack and have independent durations.
rows.reason_zh: 每次眩晕产生一层独立计时的加速，施放技能时没有逐次扣除的使用次数。

rows.quote: Spirit Breaker gains bonus Movement Speed for a duration whenever he stuns an enemy.
rows.reason_zh: 裂魂人眩晕敌人后仍会获得移动速度加成。

rows.quote: Duration pauses during Charge of Darkness.
rows.reason_zh: 暗影冲刺期间会暂停加速计时，神行太保本身没有提供主动位移。

rows.quote: whenever he stuns an enemy
rows.reason_zh: 眩晕敌人是获得加速的触发条件，神行太保本身没有施加眩晕。

rows.quote: Spirit Breaker gains movement speed and status resistance to ram through enemies.
rows.reason_zh: 持续时间从8秒缩至7秒，移速加成仍然生效。

rows.quote: Can be used while charging.
rows.reason_zh: 威吓可在冲刺途中使用，本身没有发起冲刺或其他位移。

rows.quote: Spirit Breaker gains movement speed and status resistance to ram through enemies.
rows.reason_zh: 裂魂人仍获得状态抗性，调整的只是持续时间。

rows.quote: All enemy units passed through and the targeted unit will be hit by a Greater Bash.
rows.reason_zh: 重击半径从300缩至275，一次冲刺仍可对沿途敌人和目标造成重击伤害。

rows.quote: All enemy units passed through and the targeted unit will be hit by a Greater Bash.
rows.reason_zh: 冲刺仍会对沿途敌人和目标施加巨力重击。

rows.quote: starts charging through all objects
rows.reason_zh: 这里的 charging 指冲向目标，说明中没有按施放次数消耗的充能。

rows.quote: Spirit Breaker gains shared vision of the target.
rows.reason_zh: 裂魂人仍会获得目标的共享视野。

rows.quote: starting at %min_movespeed_bonus_pct%%% of the bonus speed and reaching his max speed after %windup_time%s
rows.reason_zh: 基础冲刺仍提供移速加成，并会加速至最高速度。

rows.quote: Spirit Breaker passes through trees, cliffs, and units.
rows.reason_zh: 冲刺期间裂魂人仍能穿过单位。

rows.quote: Spirit Breaker fixes his sight on an enemy unit and starts charging through all objects
rows.reason_zh: 施放技能仍会使裂魂人主动冲向选定敌人。

rows.quote: All enemy units passed through and the targeted unit will be hit by a Greater Bash.
rows.reason_zh: 冲刺仍会施加巨力重击，巨力重击的说明明确包含眩晕。

rows.quote: Spirit Breaker passes through trees, cliffs, and units.
rows.reason_zh: 裂魂人冲刺时仍可穿过树木、越过悬崖。

rows.quote: Spirit Breaker passes through trees, cliffs, and units.
rows.reason_zh: 冲刺也能越过悬崖，超出了穿树词条限定的通行范围。

rows.quote: Spirit Breaker fixes his sight on an enemy unit and starts charging
rows.reason_zh: 施放冲刺时仍会选定一个敌方单位。

rows.quote: Gives a chance to stun and knockback an enemy unit on an attack.
rows.reason_zh: 基础重击仍作用于一个攻击目标，碰撞波及第二个敌人的效果列在A杖说明中。

rows.quote: the second enemy is bashed (creeps only receive %cascading_bashes_creep_penalty%%% damage), and the original target takes %cascading_bashes_damage_multiplier%%% of Greater Bash's damage again.
rows.reason_zh: 有A杖时，被击退的敌人撞上另一敌人仍能使两者都受到伤害。

rows.quote: If a knocked-back enemy collides with another enemy, the second enemy is bashed
rows.reason_zh: A杖碰撞仍会对第二个敌人施加重击。

rows.quote: Break disables the passive percent Chance to Bash.
rows.reason_zh: 基础攻击仍有概率触发重击，本次只下调了伤害系数。

rows.quote: Break disables the passive percent Chance to Bash. Does not disable Greater Bash application from Charge of Darkness or Nether Strike.
rows.reason_zh: 仅伤害字段有变，原有可被破坏判定仍限于被动重击概率。

rows.quote: Gives a chance to stun and knockback an enemy unit on an attack.
rows.reason_zh: 基础重击由攻击按概率触发，没有按次消耗的技能充能。

rows.quote: knockback an enemy unit on an attack
rows.reason_zh: 重击仍会击退敌方单位。

rows.quote: knockback an enemy unit on an attack
rows.reason_zh: 位移发生在被击退的敌人身上，施法者没有获得位移。

rows.quote: Gives a chance to stun and knockback an enemy unit on an attack.
rows.reason_zh: 基础攻击触发重击时仍能眩晕敌人。

rows.quote: making any unit-targeted spells cast by enemy heroes get redirected towards Spirit Breaker
rows.reason_zh: 敌方指向技能仍会转向裂魂人并继续生效，本次魔抗调整没有加入技能格挡。

rows.quote: Can be cast on both allied and enemy heroes
rows.reason_zh: 施放时仍可直接选择敌方英雄。

rows.quote: Break disables the gaining of new stacks from kills.
rows.reason_zh: 本次只提高每层回蓝，破坏仍会阻止通过击杀获得新层数。

rows.quote: Loses %charges_per_death% charges per death.
rows.reason_zh: 层数决定回蓝量并随死亡扣减，没有逐次施放消耗的使用次数。

rows.quote: mp_per_kill: 0.2→0.25
rows.reason_zh: 每层提供的法力恢复从0.2提高至0.25，自身回蓝仍成立。

rows.quote: released in a burst on Storm's next attack, dealing damage and slowing nearby enemies
rows.reason_zh: 强化攻击仍会爆发并对附近多个敌人造成伤害。

rows.quote: released in a burst on Storm's next attack, dealing damage and slowing nearby enemies
rows.reason_zh: 施法后的下一次普攻仍附带伤害与减速。

rows.quote: Casting a spell creates an electrical charge
rows.reason_zh: 两版触发说明相同且没有 IsBreakable 字段变化，沿用原有的可被破坏判定。

rows.quote: Casting a spell creates an electrical charge, which is released in a burst on Storm's next attack
rows.reason_zh: 电荷随下一次普攻释放，基础技能没有逐次施放消耗的充能。

rows.quote: Can be activated to grant Storm Spirit and nearby allied heroes %shard_activation_charges% Overload charges.
rows.reason_zh: 魔晶主动施放会赋予若干次强化攻击，电荷记录的是剩余强化攻击次数。

rows.quote: dealing damage and slowing nearby enemies
rows.reason_zh: 超负荷爆发仍会减速附近敌人。

rows.quote: deals damage and stuns enemy units in a small area around the target
rows.reason_zh: 风暴之拳仍能伤害目标周围小范围内的多个敌人。

rows.quote: applies a basic dispel on the target
rows.reason_zh: A杖升级仍会对目标施加弱驱散。

rows.quote: Affects invulnerable units.
rows.reason_zh: A杖允许技能影响已处于无敌状态的单位，说明没有赋予任何单位无敌或不可选取状态。

rows.quote: If alt-cast, it deals an additional %scepter_bonus_damage% damage and Sven travels with the Storm Hammer.
rows.reason_zh: 装备A杖并使用切换施法时，斯温仍会随锤移动。

rows.quote: stuns enemy units in a small area around the target
rows.reason_zh: 基础技能仍能眩晕目标周围的敌方单位。

rows.quote: Sven travels with the Storm Hammer.
rows.reason_zh: A杖切换施法的随锤移动方式保留，本次射程和弹速调整没有改变原行的地形通行判定。

rows.quote: deals damage and stuns enemy units in a small area around the target
rows.reason_zh: 技能仍围绕所选目标结算范围效果，本次没有施法目标变更。

rows.quote: AbilityManaCost: [30,35,40,45]→[45]
rows.reason_zh: 改动涉及魔耗与魔晶护盾量，没有 IsBreakable 字段变化，基础条件下沿用原拒绝判断。

rows.quote: base_barrier_amount.shard: 300→350
rows.reason_zh: 魔晶提供的物理伤害护盾从300提高至350。

rows.quote: increasing their armor and movement speed
rows.reason_zh: 基础战吼仍能提高友方英雄的移速。

rows.quote: The explosion deals full damage if the target is within %min_distance% radius and decreases down to %outer_damage%%% on the edge.
rows.reason_zh: 地雷爆炸仍会在范围内造成伤害，伤害量随目标距爆心的距离变化。

rows.quote: AbilityChargeRestoreTime: [15]→[14,13,12]
rows.reason_zh: 充能恢复时间改为随等级变化，各级仍有充能恢复时间。

rows.quote: Grants 30 gold if destroyed by an enemy hero.
rows.reason_zh: 30金是敌方英雄摧毁地雷取得的赏金，不属于额外经济收益。

rows.quote: Plant an invisible mine that cannot be detected by True Sight
rows.reason_zh: 隐身的是布下的地雷，技能没有向英雄、队友、召唤物或复制体赋予隐身。
各级魔抗削减量均下降，但仍大于零。

rows.quote: Mines are triggered by invisible units.
rows.reason_zh: 隐身单位能够触发地雷，说明没有使该单位显形的效果。

rows.quote: damaging enemies in an area around it
rows.reason_zh: 基础技能留下的爆桶仍会伤害周围多个敌人。

rows.quote: Break disables the bonus mana regeneration.
rows.reason_zh: 新增说明明确破坏会禁用额外回蓝，与原拒绝判断冲突，但材料未给出本词条以之为准的 IsBreakable 值。

rows.quote: Techies gain a percentage of their mana pool as bonus mana regeneration.
rows.reason_zh: 工程师仍按自身法力池的一定比例获得额外法力恢复。

rows.quote: the charge explodes, disarming all enemies within the radius and dealing damage
rows.reason_zh: 电荷爆炸仍会伤害半径内的多个敌人。

rows.quote: Enemies attacking the target take damage and are temporarily disarmed and get a Basic Dispel.
rows.reason_zh: 攻击受电击保护目标的敌人仍会受到弱驱散。

rows.quote: Techies trigger an electric charge on the target ally
rows.reason_zh: 电荷是施加给友方的定时爆炸效果，说明没有按施放次数消耗的充能。

rows.quote: Enemies attacking the target take damage
rows.reason_zh: 受保护目标遭到攻击时，攻击者仍会受到反击伤害。

rows.quote: disarming all enemies within the radius
rows.reason_zh: 电荷爆炸仍会缴械半径内所有敌人。

rows.quote: giving them bonus movement speed for a short period of time
rows.reason_zh: 被选中的友方单位仍会暂时获得移速加成。

rows.quote: dealing damage in an area around the detonation
rows.reason_zh: 引爆倒计时从2秒缩至1.5秒，爆炸仍会造成范围伤害。

rows.quote: applying a secondary slow for %secondary_slow_duration% seconds
rows.reason_zh: 炸弹附着时的移速减缓和爆炸后的第二段减速均保留，新增的眩晕字段没有给出生效值。

rows.quote: in a %trap_radius% radius. Trap movement slow charges up to %movement_speed_max%%% after %trap_max_charge_duration% seconds. Deals damage after %trap_max_charge_duration%s.
rows.reason_zh: 陷阱蓄满后仍能在触发半径内造成伤害。

rows.quote: Trap movement slow charges up to %movement_speed_max%%% after %trap_max_charge_duration% seconds.
rows.reason_zh: 蓄力时间决定减速强度，不涉及每次施放扣除一点使用次数。

rows.quote: They have invisibility that fades in over %trap_fade_time% seconds and spell immunity.
rows.reason_zh: 陷阱自身仍具有技能免疫。

rows.quote: They have invisibility that fades in over %trap_fade_time% seconds and spell immunity.
rows.reason_zh: 逐渐隐身的是按攻击扣除生命格的陷阱，技能没有向词条所列单位赋予隐身。

rows.quote: When activated, traps now silence affected enemies.
rows.reason_zh: 两版A杖说明都保留了陷阱触发时沉默敌人的效果。

rows.quote: they exert a slowing influence of %movement_speed_min%%% in a %trap_radius% radius
rows.reason_zh: 基础陷阱触发后仍会降低范围内敌人的移速。

new_mechanisms.quote: Creeps and illusions deal 25% damage to them.
new_mechanisms.reason_zh: 7.42明确把幻象与小兵列入只对陷阱造成25%伤害的来源，旧说明仅列小兵及近远程英雄的摧毁次数。

rows.quote: providing Terrorblade and nearby illusions bonus movement, HP Regen and attack speed
rows.reason_zh: 本次只下调攻速加成，原魔晶条件下的移速加成仍保留。

rows.quote: providing Terrorblade and nearby illusions bonus movement, HP Regen and attack speed
rows.reason_zh: 技能仍为恐怖利刃和符合条件的附近幻象提供生命恢复。

rows.quote: Affected enemy heroes have movement and attack speeds slowed
rows.reason_zh: 受影响敌方英雄的攻击速度仍会降低。

rows.quote: Reflections are untargetable, invulnerable illusions
rows.reason_zh: 技能制造的倒影仍明确属于幻象。

rows.quote: Reflections are untargetable, invulnerable illusions
rows.reason_zh: 倒影仍处于不可选取且无敌的状态。

rows.quote: Affected enemy heroes have movement and attack speeds slowed
rows.reason_zh: 受影响敌方英雄的移动速度仍会降低。

rows.quote: Reflections can only attack their source.
rows.reason_zh: 倒影会攻击其对应的敌方英雄，技能没有把指向技能反弹给施法者的效果。

rows.quote: a wave to travel outwards in all directions forcing enemy heroes to become Feared upon impact and dealing damage
rows.reason_zh: 向四周扩散的波仍能伤害多个敌方英雄，本次提高伤害并缩短冷却，原A杖行仍成立。

rows.quote: forcing enemy heroes to become Feared upon impact
rows.reason_zh: 波命中敌方英雄时仍会施加恐惧。

rows.quote: bonus_mana_regen: 6→5
rows.reason_zh: 装备的法力恢复加成从6降至5，仍提供自身回蓝。
